title: Burner Pump
brief: Tap the burner faster than the hot-air balloon cools and the gusts steal heat. Fill it to 30 heat to lift off before the 30-second clock runs out; let the heat reach 0 and the flame goes out.

title: Clover Patch
brief: Nine leafy patches, five picks: tap a patch to reveal a plain clover, a lucky four-leaf clover or a bee. Find three four-leaf clovers to win; two stings or running out of picks loses, and patches that twitch give the bees away.

title: Apple Archer
brief: Apples swing along three branches at different speeds; tap to loose an arrow straight up and aim ahead of them, while a wasp swats arrows out of the air. Hit 10 apples (the golden one counts double) before the 15 arrows run out.

title: Bakery Ovens
brief: Loaves in two (later three) ovens bake from pale dough to golden to burnt, each at its own random pace. Tap a loaf while it is golden to fill an order and pull burnt ones before they catch fire; bake 15 loaves to win, three fires fill the kitchen with smoke and lose.

title: Echo Chimes
brief: The wind plays a short tune on four hanging chimes; tap them back in the same order. Three songs of 3, 4 and 5 notes, each played faster; a wrong chime costs one of three lives and the tune plays again.

title: Honey Harvest
brief: Tap the hive to scoop honey into your pot and tap the jar to pour it in; two scoops a trip are safe, every extra scoop pays more but the angry bees may sting and spill the pot. Fill the jar with 30 honey before the sun sets after 30 seconds; three stings lose.

title: Firefly Jar
brief: Fireflies light up at random spots in a dark meadow and fade within about a second; tap them while they glow. Catch 20 before dawn (45 seconds) to win, but grey moths light up too and tapping three of them scares the fireflies off.

title: Flock Count
brief: A flock of white doves and dark crows streaks across the sky; count only the doves, then tap the matching number from 0 to 6. Six right answers win and three wrong ones lose; after three right answers the flocks fly faster.

title: Lantern Ring
brief: A light races around a ring of eight paper lanterns that take new colours every round; tap STOP to land it on one. Gold is worth 3 points, silver 1 and red costs one of three lives; reach 20 points to win while the light speeds up at 6 and 13.

title: Stone Skipper
brief: A power needle sweeps back and forth; tap the lake to throw a stone while the needle sits in the green zone, which the wind moves after every throw. A throw in the zone skips 3 times, a near miss once; reach 15 skips with 10 stones to win.

title: Circus Juggle
brief: Tap the falling balls to toss them back up before they hit the stage; a second ball joins at 10 seconds, a third at 25, and later all three shrink. Floating stars are worth 3 tosses; reach 45 tosses to win, three drops send the crowd home.

title: Pancake Tower
brief: A spatula slides back and forth above a plate; tap anywhere to drop its pancake so it lands on the plate or on top of the stack, and blue berry pancakes count double. Stack 16 to win; three pancakes on the table lose, and the spatula speeds up at 5 and 10.

title: Stage Notes
brief: Notes fall down three lanes to the band's beat through intro, verse, bridge, solo and chorus; tap each note while it is inside the glowing band, since early taps and notes that slip past are misses. Ten hits in a row start double-point HYPE; finish the song with 50 points for an encore, ten misses get you booed off.

title: Teacup Shuffle
brief: A sugar cube is shown under one of three teacups, then the cups swap places in arcs, more swaps and faster in each of three rounds. Tap the cup hiding the sugar to move on and win the final round; a wrong cup costs one of three lives and the round is shuffled again.

title: Rooftop Garden
brief: Tap the sunflower for seeds and spend them on watering cans and beehives that harvest by themselves, or a greenhouse that doubles every tap, while tapping away the aphids that crawl on and nibble your seeds. Fill the seed jar with 150 seeds to win; six aphids on the flower at once lose the garden.

title: Galley Drum
brief: Tap the oars right as the drum booms: a stroke on the beat moves your boat a length ahead, a stroke between beats loses one. Reach the flag before the rival boat in two races; the second has a faster beat, a faster rival and a current that sometimes pulls you back.
